Add a written scenario, a supervisor observing each attempt, and a debrief that records which visual cues misled participants. Keep the files in a restricted training folder and mark every exported image so it cannot be mistaken for an authentic credential after the session. That produces useful staff practice while keeping the prop’s purpose and limitations clear.
